reason: The October 2025 closure cannot be told to the standard. It was announced by the company in an email to customers ('severe financial distress', unable to 'process funds or settle claims'; BusinessDay 23 Oct 2025, TechCabal and Launch Base Africa 24 Oct 2025) after both founders had gone: Ercin Eksin left by 2021-2023 and Tunde Kehinde stepped down in October 2024. Neither founder has publicly explained the closure (seven searches found no statement from either after the shutdown, and the loadable reports quote only the company email). The only founder statement on causes is Eksin's earlier allegation that investors 'took control of the company in an unjust manner' and that he is litigating them in the US, which is unresolved and has no court or regulator finding, so the causes cannot be attributed to founders' statements as instructed, and there is no founder decision at the centre of the episode. Customers' funds were left frozen and staff pay reportedly lapsed, which makes an unattributed account inappropriate. Alternatives were considered: the 2023 exit from Poland and the Czech Republic is documented only by Daba Finance (company figures and a paraphrased Kehinde line) and Techpoint (blocked), and the 2016 founding only through funding announcements and a 2020 TechCrunch event write-up, none of which gives a single episode with what the founders knew and chose.
